note: WP6: zx-p1 n8 on real Garnet (19 qubits, QB14 out), 60 test graphs + 20x3 equivariance copies, 2000 shots, 2 jobs (100-circuit limit), readout mitigation as separate rows

config.threshold_from: exact model, best F1 on the full validation split
config.transpile: optimization_level=3 for IQMFakeGarnet.target (VF2 layout first); the same physical circuits run on fakegarnet and hardware
config.mitigation: per-qubit readout errors from all-zeros/all-ones circuits in the same job

notes.val: exact model on the full validation split (hardware runs no validation circuits)
notes.test: hardware (qpu) raw scores on the 60 selected test graphs
notes.subset: test graphs that embed with 0 SWAPs come first, so the subset favours small, simple graphs; compare modes on it, not with the full-test-split runs
notes.threshold: noise pulls every score towards logistic(beta0), so F1 at the exact threshold also measures that shift; PR-AUC is threshold free
notes.recall_at_fpr: with few negatives, R@1%FPR means recall with no false positive
notes.qubits: layouts are IQMFakeGarnet indices; hardware_qubits are chip qubit names
